plaatsen.tekst: And the man said, The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.

Behold now, thy servant hath found grace in thy sight, and thou hast magnified thy mercy, which thou hast shewed unto me in saving my life; and I cannot escape to the mountain, lest some evil take me, and I die:

But as for thee, stand thou here by me, and I will speak unto thee all the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which thou shalt teach them, that they may do them in the land which I give them to possess

When thou art departed from me to day, then thou shalt find two men by Rachel's sepulchre in the border of Benjamin at Zelzah; and they will say unto thee, The asses which thou wentest to seek are found: and, lo, thy father hath left the care of the asses, and sorroweth for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
And Jonathan answered Saul, David earnestly asked leave of me to go to Bethlehem:
Thou renewest thy witnesses against me, and increasest thine indignation upon me; changes and war
My glory was fresh in me, and my bow was renewed in my hand.
For the arrows of the Almighty are within me, the poison whereof drinketh up my spirit: the terrors of God do set themselves in array
